config.building_palette.title: Building Palette
config.building_palette.preview.help: Show the colored preview of the piece you are about to place. Off by default.
config.building_palette.precise.help: Off: slabs and stairs use normal placement, including stair facing and corners. On: use the clicked half-grid position. Steps and corners always use half-grid placement. Applies only to you. Neither mode allows air placement.
tooltip.building_palette.remainder: %s/8 material reserved; scroll to use it
tooltip.building_palette.scroll: Hold Alt and scroll to select shape
config.building_palette.highlight.help: Off: use Minecraft’s normal selection outline. On: highlight combined parts with your chosen hue. This does not change the placement preview.
